> **Required packages:** [`Dapper.FluentMap`](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Dapper.FluentMap), [`Npgsql`](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Npgsql)

## Problem solved

Apply FluentMap above an Npgsql connection and explicit SQL aliases.

## When to use it

Use this capability when the column shape and .NET model should remain separated by explicit, reviewable configuration.

## Example

```csharp
await using var connection = new NpgsqlConnection(connectionString);
var rows = connection.Query<Customer>(
    "SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM customers");
```

## How it works

FluentMap registers typed metadata and applies it through the matching materialization path. SQL, connections, parameters, and lifecycle remain responsibilities of the application and Dapper.

## Constraints

:::caution
Initialize before concurrent queries and treat the effective configuration as read-only afterward.
:::
